upsert.title: Vaxleukin-15 (recombinant canine IL-15) for canine mammary tumors
upsert.center: Vaxcell Bio / Yuhan distribution through veterinary hospitals
upsert.status: Approved and commercially available in South Korea
upsert.notes: Vaxleukin-15 (recombinant canine IL-15) is an approved veterinary immunoadjuvant treatment in South Korea. For canine mammary tumors, the approved use is in combination with surgical standard-of-care treatment, not as a replacement for surgery. The mammary-tumor indication was approved in 2024. Current 2026 company materials state that the product is being sold in South Korea through Yuhan. This is treatment access, not an actively recruiting clinical trial.

upsert.title: Vaxleukin-15 (recombinant canine IL-15) for canine lymphoma
upsert.center: Vaxcell Bio / Yuhan distribution through veterinary hospitals
upsert.status: Approved and commercially available in South Korea
upsert.notes: Vaxleukin-15 (recombinant canine IL-15) received the South Korean lymphoma indication in September 2025. The approved use is as an immunoadjuvant alongside standard chemotherapy, not as a replacement for chemotherapy. Current 2026 company materials list both canine lymphoma and mammary tumors as being sold in South Korea through Yuhan. This is treatment access, not an actively recruiting clinical trial. Final prescribing/eligibility decisions are made by the treating veterinarian.
